correctness.rationale: The component incidence census is exhaustive by explicit line intersections and Bézout. The conic is smooth because its symmetric matrix has determinant -32. Exact arithmetic gives rank 42 for the 78-by-45 degree-four Jacobian-syzygy matrix, hence a degree-four syzygy; Gałecka Proposition 4.1 gives the matching lower bound. With tau=36, Gałecka Theorem 3.2 then proves near freeness.
